# Lelele Game (了了了游) — LLM / Agent Setup

> Read this file first. It explains the platform from a **game developer / integrator** point of view.
> You do NOT need to read the repository source code to build or integrate a game here.
> Site: https://game.leleleling.site · Analytics: https://analytics.leleleling.site
> Version baseline: 4.4.1 (SW v1.29) · Game rules 5.0.0 · Data: 42 games / 10 authors.

## What this site is

A bilingual (Chinese / English) indie game portal. Players browse games, favorite them, and play them
in a standalone player. Developers submit games and read per-game statistics. Everything is a static
site (GitHub Pages) plus a Cloudflare Worker backend for analytics.

## For game developers — how to submit

1. Read the rules: https://game.leleleling.site/game_rules.html (v5.0.0).
2. Every game MUST provide three legal agreements: EULA, Privacy Policy, Terms of Service.
   - External/embedded games: provide your EULA / Privacy / Terms URLs in the submission form.
   - Code games: ship your own, or use the platform's generic agreements
     (`generic_eula.html`, `generic_privacy.html`, `generic_tos.html`).
   - Free bilingual generator: https://game.leleleling.site/legal_templates.html
3. Submission form: the "投稿" button on the homepage; author identity is matched by the developer
   display name you registered (case and space sensitive).
4. Review takes ~7 business days; you will be notified by email.
5. Full guide: https://game.leleleling.site/developer_docs.html

## Data handling (for integrators)

Game metadata, media, author info and legal agreements are hosted and maintained by the platform.
As a developer you do NOT need to know or access any internal file names or storage paths - submit
and update your game through the developer portal / submission form. For a machine-readable view of
your own game's info and statistics, use the public API below.

## Public statistics API (no key, no login, CORS `*`)

Per-game plays and net favorites:

```
GET https://analytics.leleleling.site/api/public/stats?game=<name-or-id>&range=30d&cmp=1
```

- `game`: game name (plays) or numeric id (favorites); either is accepted.
- `range`: `today`, `7d`, `30d`, `90d`, `12mo` (default `30d`).
- `cmp=1`: adds `prevTotal` for the previous period.
- Returns: `{ game, range, plays: {series,total,prevTotal}, favorites: {series,total,prevTotal} }`.
  `series` is `[{label, value}]`; `favorites` = favorites minus unfavorites.

All-event breakdown (advanced):

```
GET https://analytics.leleleling.site/api/breakdown?site=1&cmp=1&limit=1000&dim=event&range=30d
```

## Global high-score leaderboard SDK (honor system)

Developers can let players submit scores into a per-game "Global Top 10" board:

```html
<script src="https://game.leleleling.site/lelele-sdk.js"></script>
<script>window.LeleleSDK.submitScore(1234); /* optional: , { name: 'Alice' } */</script>
```

- Works only inside the platform player (games run in an iframe).
- `submitScore(score, { name })`: `score` is a non-negative number; optional `name` sets the nickname.
- Anonymous players are allowed; a random local nickname is generated automatically.
- Honor system: client-reported scores, no anti-cheat. Scores are stored/served by the platform;
  developers do not manage any database.

Event naming conventions (important):
- `play-game_<game id>` — one event each time a game starts (keyed by numeric game id; older
  `play-game_<name>` events are still compatible and merged into the same game).
- `fav-game_<game id>` / `unfav-game_<game id>` — favorite / unfavorite actions.
- Ranking score ("rank points") = net favorites × 5 + plays.

## Pages an agent should link to

- Game catalog / discovery: `/index.html`
- Game detail: `/game.html?id=<id>`
- Standalone player: `/play.html?id=<id>` (games load as `?embed=1` inside a clean shell)
- Favorites leaderboard: `/favgames.html` (params: `lang=zh|en`, `range=today|7d|30d|90d|12mo`, `limit=5|10|20|all`)
- Play/visit leaderboard: `/gamecheck.html` (same params: `lang`, `range`, `limit`)
- Visual stats dashboard: `/stats.html`
- Developer docs: `/developer_docs.html`
- Game rules: `/game_rules.html` · Legal templates: `/legal_templates.html`
- About: `/about.html`

## Embedding / player notes

- The standalone `play.html` embeds same-origin games with `?embed=1&lang=zh|en`; the game page
  detects embed mode and hides site footers, seasonal decorations and announcement popups.
- Games that block embedding show a prominent "Open in new tab" bar; fullscreen targets the game
  iframe itself and asks for confirmation first on external games.
- Game saves use browser `localStorage`; the player deliberately does not sandbox the iframe.

## Discovery & recommendations

- The homepage game library is ordered by a weighted random ranking (author level, source type,
  leaderboard position and a short "new game" boost), reshuffled only on page reload - filtering,
  search and pagination keep the same order.
- "For You" on the homepage suggests games from your local favorites (tags/category); with no
  favorites it falls back to the leaderboard top games.
- Game detail pages show "More Like This" (content similarity by tags/category/author) and a
  collapsed-by-default update log.
- Game agreements may be bilingual links (Chinese/English) supplied at submission time; the player
  opens the one matching the current interface language, falling back to platform generic agreements.

## For AI agents

- Prefer consuming the public API instead of scraping HTML.
- Respect the favorite-rate limit: each game allows at most 3 favorite/unfavorite cycles per day
  per user for analytics counting (the UI itself is never blocked).
- All user-facing strings are bilingual; switch with `?lang=en` or `localStorage['lelele_lang']`.
- Do not attempt to access authenticated developer endpoints (`/api/*` outside the public paths).
